voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. January thirty-first, nineteen twenty-one. A five-masted schooner sits aground on Diamond Shoals, sails still set.
The Carroll A. Deering. Her lifeboats were gone. So were the ship's log, the navigation equipment, and the crew's belongings.
In the galley, food appeared laid out for a meal. Rescuers found a cat aboard. Of the crew, there was no sign.
Five federal departments investigated. Piracy, mutiny, rum-runners, a hurricane. Each was a theory. None was proven.
